title: Toyota Supra Engines by Year
description: Every factory engine in the Toyota Supra by year: the 4M-E and 5M sixes, the 7M-GE and 7M-GTE, the 2JZ-GE and twin-turbo 2JZ-GTE, and the BMW-built engines of the GR Supra.
intro: The Supra began as the Celica Supra in 1979, became its own model in 1986, left the US after 1998 and returned as the GR Supra for 2020.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: A40 Celica Supra
intro: The first Celica Supra used the 4M-E and then 5M-E inline sixes.

generations.name: A70
intro: The 3.0 7M-GE and the turbocharged 7M-GTE; the A70 arrived partway through 1986.

generations.name: A90 GR Supra
intro: The GR Supra uses BMW's B58 3.0 turbo six and, for 2021–2024, the B48 2.0 turbo four.
